item.title: 1969 Rokon Trail-Breaker at No Reserve
item.description: This 1969 Rokon Trail-Breaker was refurbished in 2025 and acquired by the seller in 2026. The bike is finished in yellow with black graphics and powered by a 134cc two-stroke single paired with a three-speed transmission. Equipment includes two-wheel drive, a sprung solo saddle, a hitch mount, a side stand, a hand shifter, both kick and recoil starters, front and rear cargo racks, and 15″ hollow polished aluminum wheels, which can be used for storage or flotation. item.title: 408-Powered 1993 Ford Bronco XLT at No Reserve
item.description: This 1993 Ford Bronco XLT was the subject of a build performed by the seller following their purchase in 2020. The 5.8-liter V8 was bored and stroked to displace 408ci, and the four-speed automatic transmission was upgraded with a "Stage 2" kit from A1 transmission. It also has a Comp Cams crankshaft and camshaft, Lunati hydraulic roller lifters, AFR cylinder heads, a Trick Flow intake manifold, a 90mm throttle body, 525cc fuel injectors, and Headman exhaust headers. item.description: This 1989 BMW 325is is a Cinnabar Red-finished coupe that was purchased in 2025 by the seller, who has since replaced the timing belt, water pump, oil pan gasket, exhaust manifold gasket, clutch assembly, and more, as described below. item.title: 1962 Ford F-100 Flareside 4×4 4-Speed Project at No Reserve
item.description: This 1962 Ford F-100 Flareside 4x4 pickup is a non-running project that was sold new in California and was last registered for road use in the early 1990s. Acquired by the selling dealer in 2013, the truck has remained off the road since and was fitted with Mickey Thompson 15" wheels and 33" tires in 2024. item.title: 2002 Honda Integra Type R

Finished in Championship White over red and black cloth, the car is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four linked to a six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: Original-Owner 2010 Porsche Cayman S 6-Speed PCA/NASA Race Car
item.description: This 2010 Porsche Cayman S was acquired new by the seller, who commissioned Eksten Autoworks to build it into a race car shortly thereafter. The seller has since raced it in PCA GTB-1, NASA GTS-4, and EMRA ST-1 competition. The car rides on JRZ triple-adjustable coilovers and 18" Forgeline wheels, and the body features multiple aerodynamic modifications. item.title: 20k-Mile 2013 BMW M3 Coupe Frozen Limited Edition
item.description: This 2013 BMW M3 coupe is one of 150 Frozen Edition examples produced for the US market, and it has 20k miles through the seller's purchase in 2023. item.title: 1993 Lancia Delta Integrale Evo 1
item.description: This 1993 Lancia Delta Integrale Evo 1 was imported from Japan to Canada in 2012, and it spent time in British Columbia through the seller's acquisition in 2016. The car shows 72k kilometers (~45k miles) and rides on 17" multi-spoke wheels and an aftermarket coilover suspension. Power is provided by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four fitted with a revised exhaust system, and shifting is through a five-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 1963 Porsche 356B Cabriolet
item.description: This 1963 Porsche 356B cabriolet was acquired by the current owner in 2023 and subsequently underwent a refurbishment, including replacement floors, a reupholstered interior, and an overhaul of the engine. The car has been refinished in Oslo Blue over red leather, and is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle.
